title: Finite projective modules descend along flat local homomorphisms
statement: Let $(R,\mathfrak m_R)$ and $(S,\mathfrak m_S)$ be local rings and $\varphi:R\to S$ a local homomorphism ($\varphi(\mathfrak m_R)\subseteq\mathfrak m_S$) which is flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map]. Let $M$ be a finitely generated $R$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. Then $M$ is a projective $R$-module [def-weil-pbc-projective-module] if and only if $M\otimes_RS$ is a projective $S$-module; and in that case $M$ is a finite free $R$-module, $M\cong R^{\oplus r}$ for some $r\ge0$.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 00O1 (lemma-finite-projective-descends, line 19269) and its proof (finite projective over a local ring = finite free, Lemma Tag 00NX; a basis of M/m_R M lifts to a basis of M by faithful flatness, Lemma Tag 00HR).
